name: Square
description: Square payments become Placed Order when they complete, and refunds Refunded Order (once per refund, its own amount, when completed). Square customers become profiles held back from marketing, and customers who unsubscribed from Square's marketing emails are never sent marketing here.

signature_secret.label: Square signature key
signature_secret.help: In the Square Developer Console: your application → Webhooks → Subscriptions → your subscription → Signature key.

setup: Create the integration from this recipe and copy its webhook URL.

In the Square Developer Console, open your application → Webhooks → Subscriptions → Add subscription. Paste the webhook URL exactly as shown (Square signs the URL too, so it must match character for character).
Tick these events: payment.created, payment.updated, refund.created, refund.updated, customer.created, customer.updated. Save.
Copy the subscription's Signature key and save it as the integration's signing secret.
Send a test event from the subscription and check the delivery log. Square's resends of an event are recognized by its event_id.
Buyers are held back from marketing (Square doesn't record a marketing opt-in). People who unsubscribed from Square's marketing emails are suppressed here too.
